$comment: The workflows/99_e2e fixtures ported to Go in this directory, and the tests
the Go runtime cannot pass yet. Format: packages/core/e2e/e2e-conformance.example.json
in the Workflow SDK. Add a fixture once its tests pass.

unsupported.health check endpoint (HTTP) - workflow: A Go app has no flow route: its World runs its workflows in process.
unsupported.health check (queue-based) - workflow en: Go Worlds acknowledge a health check message without writing its response stream.
unsupported.health check (CLI) - workflow health com: Go Worlds acknowledge a health check message without writing its response stream.
unsupported.workflowAndStepMetadataWorkflow: Go's WorkflowMetadata has no url or features, and its StepMetadata has no maxAttempts.
unsupported.step-argument serialization failure is c: A Go step input that cannot be encoded fails the step with a plain Error, "workflow: encode step input: ...", not a SerializationError naming the step arguments.
unsupported.uncaught step-argument serialization fai: A Go step input that cannot be encoded fails the run with "workflow: encode step input: ...", not the SDK's "Failed to serialize step arguments" message.
unsupported.step-return-value serialization failure: A Go step output that cannot be encoded fails the step with a plain Error, "workflow: encode step output: ...", not a SerializationError naming the return value.
unsupported.uncaught step-return-value serialization: A Go step output that cannot be encoded fails the run with "workflow: encode step output: ...", not the SDK's "Failed to serialize step return value" message.
unsupported.validation DX: invalid writes throw catc: worlds.CheckAttributes words its errors in its own terms (no allowReservedAttributes hint, no "exceeds limit" phrasing), and a Go attribute map cannot be the non-object the test passes.
